reference.limits: Not published on the pages opened. - ISV development agreement + technical service agreement accepted at app creation; app review by 1688; the dropship solution promises 一件代发包邮 / 48-hour dispatch / 7-day returns for downstream sellers (Taobao, Douyin, Kuaishou, Xiaohongshu, WeChat); rate limits not readable.

config_fields.name: language
config_fields.help: Language of translated titles for search and product detail (country: en, ja, ko, es, …; see the API's developer reference).

config_fields.name: order_flow
config_fields.help: fastCreateOrder flow: general (wholesale order), saleproxy / fenxiao (一件代发 dropshipping order; the seller must have authorised proxy sales), boutiquefenxiao, …

fields.name: client_id
fields.help: appKey of your 1688 Open Platform app (it is also the last URL path segment of every call).

fields.name: client_secret
fields.help: appSecret of the same app; signs every call (_aop_signature = uppercase hex HMAC-SHA1 over the urlPath from 'param2' + sorted name+value, https://open.1688.com/doc/signature.htm) and refreshes tokens.

fields.name: refresh_token
fields.help: refresh_token from the OAuth getToken exchange (need_refresh_token=true, https://open.1688.com/doc/apiAuth.htm); valid for the service subscription period (up to half a year). Access tokens (10 hours) are minted from it.

me.note: system/currentTime (the signing example API): verifies the appKey, signature and that an access token can be minted from the refresh token.

list_products.note: 多语言关键词搜索 (cross-border keyword search): `query` is required and may be in the configured language (keywordTranslate); prices are CNY strings (price = wholesale, dropship_price = consignPrice for 一件代发). `id` is the offerId for get_product.

get_product.note: 多语言商品详情: translated title, images, attributes, productSkuInfos[{skuId, specId, price, consignPrice, amountOnSale, skuAttributes}], productSaleInfo (price ranges, 一件代发 fenxiaoSaleInfo) and shipping info. `sku` is the FIRST SKU's specId, which create_order's items take.

create_order.note: 快速创建订单 (fastCreateOrder) with the configured flow. `items` are cargoParamList [{offerId, specId, quantity}] and `shipping_address` is 1688's addressParam {fullName, mobile, phone, postCode, provinceText, cityText, areaText, townText, address} with Chinese region names (a mainland China / consolidation-warehouse address). The order is unpaid (支付宝担保交易 by default); outOrderId is a fresh UUID for idempotency.

get_order.note: 订单详情 (buyer view): status (waitbuyerpay, waitsellersend, waitbuyerreceive, success, cancel, …), totalAmount in CNY, createTime like '20170913231708000-0700'; products, nativeLogistics and invoice in raw.result.

track.note: 物流跟踪 (buyer view): one row per logistics order with the waybill number (logisticsBillNo) and logisticsSteps[{acceptTime, remark}] in time order (Chinese carrier scans).

not_offered.quote_shipping: Freight is computed inside order preview (alibaba.createOrder.preview) from a full receiver address and cargo list; there is no per-product/country freight quote in the cross-border product or trade APIs (https://open.1688.com/api/apidocdetail.htm?id=com.alibaba.trade:alibaba.trade.fastCreateOrder-1: '系统默认选择最优惠下单方式').

adapter.terms: 1688 Open Platform: https://gw.open.1688.com/openapi/param2/1/{namespace}/{api}/{appKey}?…&access_token&_aop_signature; buyer-side cross-border and ordering APIs require an ISV agreement, enrolment in the matching solution (跨境ERP/独立站SaaS, 采购解决方案 …) and the member's authorisation (https://open.1688.com/doc/apiAuth.htm).
